name: twilio-sdk
description: Install and consume the Twilio .NET SDK, grounded in a bundled SDK map. The integrate-twilio workflow skill plans a map-grounded contract sheet before any code is written, implements from it, and fixes SDK compile/build errors map-first — cloning the SDK source only when the map cannot settle a fact. Includes the twilio-getting-started map and seven dotnet-* companion skills. No MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Twilio .NET SDK integration, grounded in a bundled SDK map.
